description: React component ProgressPanel for displaying and updating user progress on skills within a role, including fetching role details, skills, and progress data, and handling status updates with optimistic UI and API calls.

methods.name: resolveRoleName
methods.description: Fetches role name based on role ID by listing roles and matching ID.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads role details, skills, and progress data, updating component state accordingly.

methods.name: updateStatus
methods.description: Updates the progress status of a skill, performs optimistic UI update, and communicates with backend API.
